subject: dsa
title: Palindromic Substrings
summary: Count palindromic substrings by expanding around every center. Each index is an odd center, each gap an even center; every successful expansion is one more palindrome.
problem: Given a string, count how many of its contiguous substrings are palindromes.

steps.caption: Count all substrings that are palindromes. Expand around every center, and each time both sides match, that is one more palindrome.
Single characters are always palindromes, so "a", "a", "a" give us 3 to start.
Even center between index 0 and 1: "aa" matches, bringing the count to 4.
Even center between index 1 and 2: "aa" matches, count 5.
Odd center at index 1: expand to index 0 vs index 2, both 'a'. "aaa" matches, count 6.
No center can expand further. The total palindromic substring count is 6.
